svg.text: SAGE PROPOSAL | MODEL DIMENSIONS - NOT A SITE SURVEY
Feet/inches rounded to 1/8 in; metric rounded to 1 mm. X = plan left/right; Y = plan up/down.
Room spans describe named bays/zones. Furniture outlines are bounding envelopes. Opening widths are wall openings, not clear passage.
Check the IDs against the plan. Heights are above the model datum; finish build-ups and hardware may reduce clearances.
